methodologyNotes: Covers indoor wall-mounted brackets for flat-panel televisions sold at a published US price. Excludes ceiling mounts, floor/tabletop stands, desktop monitor arms, motorized or robotic mounts, and outdoor-rated enclosures. Price is typical US retail (MSRP) in USD. mountType is one of full-motion, tilting, or fixed. minScreenSizeIn and maxScreenSizeIn are the manufacturer-rated TV diagonal range in inches. maxLoadLbs is the rated weight capacity in pounds. minVesaMm and maxVesaMm are the smallest and largest supported VESA hole patterns as width x height in millimeters. maxExtensionIn is how far the mount pulls the panel out from the wall at full extension, in inches (equals minDepthIn for fixed mounts). minDepthIn is the retracted profile from panel to wall, in inches. swivelRangeDeg is total left-plus-right rotation in degrees (0 for fixed/tilting-only mounts). tiltRangeDeg is total up-plus-down tilt travel in degrees (0 for fixed mounts). ulListed is true when the mount carries UL or equivalent safety certification, false when not, null if not disclosed.
